# dsh-prompt-sharpen
Pre-send checkup for prompts in DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
Most "enhance prompt" buttons rewrite whatever you typed. This one reads it first: a **zero-token li
nt** in the composer tells you which of four things your draft is still missing, and one click fills
**exactly those gaps** — no padding, no invented requirements. The original stays one click away.
## What it checks
| Gap | Looking for |

| Output format | result shape: structure, fields, length, table / code block |
| Constraints | what

must hold, what must not be done |
| Acceptance criteria | how you will know it is done or correct

|
| Context | the background, inputs or materials that make it executable |
The lint is local, rule-based and free: it never calls a model. A red dot on the button appears only
when a gap is found, and the tooltip names the gaps (`缺：输出格式、验收标准`). A draft shorter than 12 charac
ters is not checked — at that size everything is missing and the answer is noise.
## Directed, not generic
When you press the button, the gaps are passed to the model as a `【体检结果】` block:

- Missing items → fill those, and do not restate what is already written.
- All four present → strip
redundancy and tighten wording, and **add nothing**.
The rewrite replaces the draft in place. The button turns into a revert arrow; one click restores th
e exact original text. A request that fails (bad route, timeout, empty completion) never touches you
r draft — the button just shows the reason.
## Three ways in
| Surface | What it does |

| Composer button (left of the model selector) | check the draft, then sharpen it in place |
| `/sha

rpen <draft>` | same pipeline from the command line |
| `sharpen_prompt` tool | lets the agent tight

en a prompt the user is drafting |
| `checkup_prompt` tool | diagnose only — no model call, no token

a prompt the user is drafting |
| `checkup_prompt` tool | diagnose only — no model call, no tokens |
HTTP, for the UI half: `POST /api/prompt-sharpen/check` and `POST /api/prompt-sharpen/enhance`, both
taking `{ "draft": "…" }` and restricted to loopback, same-origin requests.
## Install
Desktop app: open **Plugins**, search `dsh-prompt-sharpen`, install, then restart — client bundles a
re composed at startup.

## Notes
- Zero runtime dependencies. Both halves are plain ESM/CJS and only touch `ctx` services, so `link:`

installs work too.
- The button never sends your message. You always read the result before pressin

g Enter.
- Only the draft you press the button on is sent, to the model route you configured. No tel

emetry, no storage.
- Client bundle lives at `client.js`; host half at `index.js`; both are small en
ough to read in one sitting.
